description: This Swift source file defines utility structures, enumerations, and functions for managing and checking the environment for the OpenClaw gateway, including version parsing, environment validation, command resolution, and installation procedures.

classes.name: Semver
classes.description: A helper struct for semantic versioning (major.minor.patch) with comparison, parsing, and description capabilities.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a raw version string into a Semver object, handling prefixes and suffixes.

methods.name: compatible(with:)
methods.description: Determines if the current version is compatible with a required version, based on major version equality and non-older status.
